===Contraction===
{{head|en|contractions}}

# {{senseid|en|I have}} {{contraction of|en|I|have}}.
#: {{cot|en|I'd've<id:I would have>|I'd<id:I had><qq:I had>|I'd<id:I would><qq:I would>|;|you've<id:you have>|he's<id:he has>|she's<id:she has>|it's<id:it has>|they've<id:they have>}}

====Usage notes====
* Like other ''affirmative contractions'', this cannot appear at the end of a clause.
* In American English, it is usually used only when ''have'' is used as an auxiliary verb.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|chave}} {{q|West Country|obsolete}}

* {{l|en|I'ven't}}
